Subject: Vendor onboarding — preferred invoice submission and sample rows

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call this morning. Procurement at Orchard wants to confirm whether Redwood prefers invoices via the portal or email for new suppliers, and if you can share a minimal CSV sample we should follow (we send a mix of single-line CSVs and multi-line PDFs). A few specifics we need clarified:

- Do you require a subject token or invoice ID in the email subject if we email invoices?
- Is UTF-8 (no BOM) mandatory for CSVs? Any delimiter preference (comma vs pipe) for international fields?
- How should we include PO numbers when a single invoice covers multiple POs? Do you prefer repeated line rows or a separate PO mapping file?

Attached is a quick example of how Orchard typically exports (orchard_sample_invoice.csv). We can adapt but want to avoid rework.

Appreciate the guidance — Alicia
Procurement Lead, Orchard Supplies


From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@orchard-supplies.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-14T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — preferred invoice submission and sample rows

Hi Alicia — great to meet you on the call. Short answers up front, then details: portal preferred for scale, email allowed as a backstop; yes, include a subject token for email fallback; UTF-8 without BOM preferred; comma delimiter if possible.

Details: 
- Portal: our vendor portal gives immediate ack/ID and reduces manual routing. If you can onboard to the portal, we recommend it for production volume.
- Email fallback: use subject token: ORCH-INV-<vendor-id>-<YYYYMMDD>. That lets our ingestion pipeline route and idempotently ack. Please avoid putting multiple invoices in one email thread; one invoice per message is easier.
- CSV schema: minimal required columns are: invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), total_amount, currency, line_description, line_amount, po_number, vendor_tax_id. For multiple-PO invoices we accept repeated rows (one row per PO/line) or a grouped row with a pipe-delimited po_list field — we can accept either but repeated rows are simpler for reconciliation.
- Encoding/delimiter: UTF-8 (no BOM) and comma delimiter. If you must use semicolons for regional locale, we can accept but please indicate in the subject (e.g., ;delimiter=semicolon).
- Attachments: PDFs are OK but we rely on CSVs for auto-processing. If sending a PDF as well, include a CSV for the canonical ingest.

I'm attaching our onboarding form so we have vendor details (redwood_onboarding_form.pdf). Vanessa will follow up with the portal invite and a sample compact CSV we prefer.

Best,
Soojin
Supplier Ops, Redwood Inference

Hi Alicia — Vanessa from Vendor Onboarding here. Quick operational notes and a compact sample CSV (inline) to use as a template. We can proceed with portal activation today — portal invite link will follow.

Answers: 
- BOM: our ingest pipeline can tolerate and strip a UTF-8 BOM, but it's best practice to avoid it. If your export tool cannot be configured, we will still accept files and strip the BOM during ingest; just let us know in the subject that the file includes BOM so we can confirm processing.
- JSON-in-field: acceptable as a fallback. For automated reconciliation we prefer exploded rows (one physical line per PO-line). If you send a single-line CSV with a JSON blob, include a header: transformed=true so our parser applies the JSON extraction rules.
- PO format: no strict prefix required — numeric-only POs are fine. If you have mixed formats, include the PO prefix in the po_number column exactly as you have it.

Compact CSV example (header + two lines):
invoice_number,invoice_date,total_amount,currency,line_description,line_amount,po_number,vendor_tax_id
INV-2028-0041,2028-03-01,3420.00,USD,Industrial filters,1420.00,123456,ORCH-TAX-890
INV-2028-0041,2028-03-01,3420.00,USD,Maintenance kit,2000.00,654321,ORCH-TAX-890

Operational ack rules: 
- Portal: instant ack with ingest_id in portal UI.
- Email: we provide an automated ack email within 30 minutes with an ingest_id and any parsing exceptions. If you include subject token ORCH-INV-<vendorid>-<date> we'll de-dup by token.

Portal invite: https://portal.redwood.ai/onboard/invite?token=FAKE-INVITE-12345
HubSpot record: 2345

I'll send the portal invite separately; Jordan will pick up if you need custom delimiter mappings.

Thanks,
